svg.aria-label: Two ways for 8 lanes to read 8 floats. Top: lane k reads float k. The lanes sit above floats 0 to 7, which all lie in sector 0, so one sector of 32 bytes is fetched and every byte is used. Bottom: lane k reads float 8k. Each lane sits above a different sector and uses one float of its eight, so 8 sectors, 256 bytes, are fetched for 32 useful bytes.
svg.text: Two ways for a warp to read 8 floats
Memory delivers 32-byte sectors; a load costs one fetch per sector it touches.
a float a lane asked for
